page.notes: Top line: the first letters are cut or unclear, so "stitas" is uncertain. Greek paragraph: most of the Greek is too faint to read letter by letter, so those stretches are marked illegible. Only the opening words, Ἀλλ᾽ ὅμως and Ἰγνατίου and Φωτίου, are fairly clear. "Photiuum" is printed that way and left as is. "illustriori" and "licèt" / "vero" are read at low resolution and should be checked against the original.
